language_specific.morphology: 술 + object particle 을 → 술을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 술을 [수를]. Final ㄹ links to 을. The vowel is ㅜ; 실 [실:], thread, has ㅣ and dictionary vowel length.

common.sentence: 항구에 배가 들어왔다.

language_specific.morphology: 배 + subject particle 가 → 배가.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 배가 [배가]. Initial ㅂ is plain; 패 [패], a hand in a game, has aspirated ㅍ.

common.sentence: 그는 패를 보고 게임을 포기했다.
common.meaning: hand in a game, as the object

language_specific.morphology: 패 + object particle 를 → 패를.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 패를 [패를]. The initial ㅍ is aspirated; 배 [배] has plain ㅂ and can mean a boat.

common.sentence: 농부가 밭에서 콩을 거뒀다.

language_specific.morphology: 콩 + object particle 을 → 콩을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 콩을 [콩을]. The initial ㅋ is aspirated; 공 [공] has plain ㄱ and can mean a ball.

common.sentence: 아이가 공을 담장 너머로 찼다.

language_specific.morphology: 공 + object particle 을 → 공을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 공을 [공을]. The initial ㄱ is plain; 콩 [콩], bean, has aspirated ㅋ.

common.sentence: 침을 삼켰다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 침을 [치믈]. Initial ㅊ is aspirated; final ㅁ links to 을. 짐 [짐] means luggage and has plain ㅈ.

common.sentence: 화가는 돌을 쌓아 조각을 만들었다.

language_specific.morphology: 돌 + object particle 을 → 돌을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 돌을 [도:를]. Final ㄹ links to 을, with dictionary vowel length retained. The stem vowel is ㅗ; 둘 [둘], two, has ㅜ.

common.sentence: 밤이 깊어 거리가 조용해졌다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 밤이 [바미]. Final ㅁ links to 이. The stem vowel ㅏ differs from ㅓ in 범 [범:], tiger; the latter has dictionary vowel length.

common.sentence: 눈이 와서 길이 미끄럽다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 눈이 [누:니]. The snow sense has dictionary vowel length and final ㄴ links to 이. Its vowel is ㅜ, unlike ㅗ in 논 [논], rice paddy.

common.sentence: 농부가 논에 물을 댔다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 논에 [노네]. Final ㄴ links to 에. The stem vowel ㅗ differs from ㅜ in 눈 [눈:], snow.

common.sentence: 참가자 둘이 먼저 도착했다.

language_specific.morphology: 둘 + subject particle 이 → 둘이.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 둘이 [두리]. Final ㄹ links to 이. The vowel is ㅜ; 돌 [돌:], stone, has ㅗ and dictionary vowel length.

common.sentence: 감기에 걸려 몸이 무겁다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 몸이 [모미]. Final ㅁ links to 이. The stem vowel is ㅗ; 문 [문], door, has ㅜ and a different final consonant. This is a comparison of two sound differences, not a minimal pair.

common.sentence: 그릇에 죽을 담았다.

language_specific.morphology: 죽 + object particle 을 → 죽을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 죽을 [주글]. Initial ㅈ is plain; 축 [축], an axis or axle, has aspirated ㅊ.

common.sentence: 기계의 회전축을 교체했다.

language_specific.morphology: 회전축 + object particle 을 → 회전축을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 회전축을 [회전추글] or [훼전추글]. The ㅊ in 축 is aspirated, and final ㄱ links to 을. 죽 [죽], porridge, begins with plain ㅈ.

common.sentence: 감기가 낫는다 싶더니 다시 열이 났다.

language_specific.morphology: 낫- + -는다 → 낫는다; the ㅅ-irregular stem retains written ㅅ before this consonant-initial ending.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 낫는다 [난:는다]. Stem-final ㅅ is realized as ㄷ before ㄴ and then nasalizes to ㄴ; dictionary vowel length is retained.

common.sentence: 젖은 옷을 밖에 널었다.

language_specific.morphology: 옷 + object particle 을 → 옷을.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 옷을 [오슬]. The written final ㅅ moves to the vowel-initial particle.

common.sentence: 밭에 상추를 심었다.

language_specific.morphology: 밭 + location particle 에 → 밭에.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 밭에 [바테]. The written final ㅌ moves to the vowel-initial particle.

common.sentence: 진흙이 굳어 바닥에 붙었다.

language_specific.morphology: 굳- + connective ending -어 → 굳어.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 굳어 [구더]. Stem-final ㄷ links to 어 without palatalization.

common.sentence: 봉투에 우표를 붙여 보냈다.

language_specific.morphology: 붙- + causative suffix -이- + connective ending -어 → 붙이어 → 붙여.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 붙여 [부처]. Written ㅌ is palatalized before the suffix 이; 이어 contracts to 여.

common.sentence: 오래 앉는 자세가 허리에 부담을 준다.

language_specific.morphology: 앉- + present attributive ending -는 → 앉는.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 앉는 [안는]. The written cluster ㄵ is realized as ㄴ before the consonant-initial ending.

common.sentence: 손잡이를 잡는 힘이 약해졌다.

language_specific.morphology: 잡- + present attributive ending -는 → 잡는.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 잡는 [잠는]. Stem-final ㅂ is pronounced ㅁ before ㄴ.

common.sentence: 연락을 받으면 바로 출발하자.
common.meaning: contact or a message, as object

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 연락을 [열라글]. ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ; the final ㄱ then links to 을.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 연락을 받다: receive a message or contact.
language_specific.morphology: 연락 + 을 marks the object.

common.sentence: 밥솥의 전원을 껐다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 밥솥의 [밥쏘틔/밥쏘테]. ㅅ is tensed after ㅂ, and final ㅌ links to 의. The genitive 의 permits [의] or [에] here; it does not trigger palatalization.
language_specific.morphology: 밥솥 + 의 marks possession.

common.sentence: 비가 오는데 굳이 걸어갈 필요는 없다.

language_specific.morphology: 굳- + adverb-forming suffix -이 → 굳이.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 굳이 [구지]. Written ㄷ is palatalized to ㅈ before the suffix 이.

common.sentence: 바람에 창문이 닫혀 버렸다.

language_specific.morphology: 닫히- + connective ending -어 → 닫혀, with 히어 contracted to 혀.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 닫혀 [다쳐]. ㄷ and ㅎ produce aspirated ㅌ, palatalized to ㅊ in the 이/ㅕ environment of -히- and contracted 히어 → 혀.

common.sentence: 고양이가 앞발을 핥아 닦았다.

language_specific.morphology: 핥- + connective ending -아 → 핥아.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 핥아 [할타]. In the written cluster ㄾ, ㄹ remains as the coda and ㅌ links to 아.

common.sentence: 고양이가 털을 핥는 모습이 보였다.

language_specific.morphology: 핥- + present attributive ending -는 → 핥는.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 핥는 [할른]. The cluster ㄾ is realized as ㄹ before ㄴ, and the following ㄴ is pronounced ㄹ.

common.sentence: 새해 첫날 해돋이를 보러 갔다.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 해돋이를 [해도지를]. ㄷ is palatalized before the noun-forming suffix 이; 를 is included in this actual host.
language_specific.morphology: 해돋이 + 를 marks the object; 돋- + noun-forming -이 is part of the noun 해돋이.

common.sentence: 서류를 책상에 놓고 나왔다.

language_specific.morphology: 놓- + connective ending -고 → 놓고.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 놓고 [노코]. Stem-final ㅎ combines with the following ㄱ as aspirated ㅋ.

common.sentence: 시인이 무대에서 시를 읊는 모습이 인상적이었다.

language_specific.morphology: 읊- + present attributive ending -는 → 읊는.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 읊는 [음는]. The written cluster ㄿ is realized as ㅂ before ㄴ, and that sound nasalizes to ㅁ.

common.sentence: 나는 커피보다 차가 좋아.

language_specific.morphology: 좋- + -아 → 좋아, a casual form of 좋다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 좋아 [조아]. Stem-final ㅎ is silent before the vowel-initial ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 커피보다 차가 좋아: like tea more than coffee.

common.sentence: 신발 밑창이 닳는 속도가 빠르다.

language_specific.morphology: 닳- + present attributive ending -는 → 닳는.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 닳는 [달른]. The ㅎ in the written cluster ㄹㅎ is silent before ㄴ, and ㄴ is pronounced ㄹ after ㄹ.

common.sentence: 젊은 연구자들이 토론에 참여했다.

language_specific.morphology: 젊- + attributive ending -은 → 젊은.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 젊은 [절믄]. In the written final cluster ㄻ, ㄹ stays in the first syllable and ㅁ moves to the vowel-initial ending.

common.sentence: 반죽을 넓게 펴서 구웠다.

language_specific.morphology: 넓- + adverbial ending -게 → 넓게.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 넓게 [널께]. The written final cluster ㄼ is realized as ㄹ, and the following ㄱ is tense.

common.sentence: 오늘은 버스로 가고, 내일은 걸어가요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Group 오늘은 버스로 가고 and 내일은 걸어가요 separately; give 오늘은 contrastive prominence and make a small continuation break after 가고.

common.sentence: 차 말고 물 주세요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Keep 차 말고 together, then give 물 prominence before continuing to 주세요; a gentle fall can complete the request.

common.sentence: 수진 씨가 왔어요, 민수 씨가 왔어요?

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Give 수진 씨가 and 민수 씨가 comparable prominence, with a continuation contour after the first alternative and a questioning contour at the end.

common.sentence: 문은 열고 창은 닫아 주세요.
common.meaning: the door, as a contrasted topic

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Group 문은 열고 and 창은 닫아 주세요 separately; make the two topics prominent to clarify the contrasting actions.

common.sentence: 지금 출발해요? 네, 출발해요.
common.meaning: now, as the time being checked

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: In the question, give 지금 prominence to check the departure time, then use a questioning contour on 출발해요.

common.sentence: 화요일에, 아니, 수요일에 만나요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Leave a brief break around 아니, then give 수요일에 prominence as the corrected day before continuing to 만나요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수요일에 만나다: meet on Wednesday.

common.sentence: 빨간 상자 안에 열쇠가 있어요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Keep 빨간 상자 안에 as one location group, then make a light boundary before 열쇠가 있어요.

common.sentence: 우유, 달걀, 빵을 샀어요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Separate the items with light boundaries; use a continuing contour on 달걀 before completing the list with 빵을 샀어요.

common.sentence: 먼저 이름을 쓰고, 아래에 서명하세요.
common.meaning: first, in a sequence of actions

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Give 먼저 prominence, group it with 이름을 쓰고, and pause briefly before the next instruction.

common.sentence: 다 준비됐어? 응, 다 됐어.

language_specific.morphology: 됐어 is 되- + -었어, contracted from 되었어; 다 modifies the completed state.
language_specific.prosody: Sentence: After a short boundary following 응, say 다 됐어 as a single answer group with a settling fall.

common.sentence: 이건 제가 할게요. 저건 부탁해요.
common.meaning: I, as the person taking this task

language_specific.morphology: 제가 is the subject form of 저 with -가; 저 + 가 changes to 제가.
language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Give 제가 prominence in the first sentence to identify the person taking this task; separate the two sentences clearly.

common.sentence: 작은 컵에 담아 주세요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Keep 작은 컵에 together; prominence on 작은 can distinguish the requested cup by size.

common.sentence: 언제까지요? 열 시까지요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Use a questioning contour on 언제까지요, then a settling fall on 열 시까지요 to give the time.

common.sentence: 갈 수는 있어요. 하지만 늦을 거예요.
common.meaning: can go, with a qualification to follow

language_specific.morphology: 갈 is 가- + -ㄹ, 수 is a dependent noun, 는 marks contrast, and 있어요 is 있- + -어요.
language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Give 수는 prominence and allow a slight continuation at 있어요, then state the qualification 하지만 늦을 거예요.

common.sentence: 잠깐만요, 아직 다 안 썼어요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Say 잠깐만요 as a separate attention-getting group, pause briefly, then give the explanation.

common.sentence: 책은 읽었는데 영화는 못 봤어요.
common.meaning: the film, as a contrasted topic

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Mark a boundary after 읽었는데 and give 영화는 contrastive prominence before 못 봤어요.

common.sentence: 문을 닫았어요? 아니요, 열어 뒀어요.

language_specific.morphology: 열어 is 열- + -어; 뒀어요 is 두- + -었어요, contracted from 두었어요.
language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Separate 아니요 from the correction; give 열어 prominence to contrast the open state with the question.

common.sentence: 이거, 여기 놓으면 돼요?
common.meaning: here, as the location being checked

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Leave a brief boundary after 이거, then give 여기 prominence and use a questioning contour at 돼요.

common.sentence: 한 번 더, 천천히 말씀해 주세요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Group 한 번 더 together, pause lightly, and give 천천히 its own prominence to make both parts of the request clear.

common.sentence: 끝났어요! 이제 쉬어요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: Give 끝났어요 an energetic falling finish, then leave a clear boundary before 이제 쉬어요.

common.sentence: 안내문: “출입을 금합니다.” 직원: “들어오지 마세요.”

language_specific.morphology: 들어오지 마세요 combines 들어오- + -지 with the polite prohibition 마세요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice states the prohibition in formal writing; an employee expresses it politely in speech.

common.sentence: 안내문: “신발을 벗으십시오.” 직원: “신발을 벗어 주세요.”

language_specific.morphology: 벗어 is 벗- + -어; 주세요 is the polite request form of 주다.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice gives a formal instruction; an employee gives the same instruction politely.

common.sentence: 공지: “내일 휴관합니다.” 직원: “내일 쉬어요.”

language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A public notice and an employee describe the same closure.

common.sentence: 안내문: “주차할 수 없습니다.” 직원: “주차 못 해요.”

language_specific.morphology: 못 negates the ability or possibility expressed by 주차하다; 해요 contracts 하- + -여요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state that parking is unavailable.

common.sentence: 공지: “접수가 끝났습니다.” 직원: “접수가 끝났어요.”

language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee report that registration has ended.

common.sentence: 공지: “오늘 비가 올 수 있습니다.” 직원: “오늘 비가 올 수 있어요.”

language_specific.morphology: 올 is 오- + prospective modifier -ㄹ; 수 있어요 expresses possibility.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and a speaker both state a possibility.

common.sentence: 안내문: “예약이 필요합니다.” 직원: “예약해야 해요.”

language_specific.morphology: 예약해야 combines 예약하- + -여야, contracted to 예약해야; 해요 contracts 하- + -여요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state the reservation requirement.

common.sentence: 공지: “오늘 배송하지 않습니다.” 직원: “오늘 배송 안 해요.”

language_specific.morphology: 안 negates 배송하다; 해요 contracts 하- + -여요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state that deliveries will not be made today.

common.sentence: 안내문: “문을 닫아 주십시오.” 직원: “문 좀 닫아 주세요.”

language_specific.morphology: 닫아 is 닫- + -아; 주세요 is the polite request form of 주다.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee politely request that the door be closed.

common.sentence: 공지: “입장료는 없습니다.” 직원: “입장료는 안 받아요.”

language_specific.morphology: 안 negates 받아요, the polite present form of 받다.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee say that there is no admission charge.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 입장료는 안 받다: not charge an admission fee.

common.sentence: 공지: “비가 오면 취소합니다.” 직원: “비가 오면 취소해요.”
common.meaning: if it comes, it will be canceled

language_specific.morphology: 오면 is 오- + -면; 취소해요 contracts 취소하- + -여요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state the same cancellation condition.

common.sentence: 안내문: “사진 촬영이 가능합니다.” 직원: “사진 찍어도 돼요.”

language_specific.morphology: 찍어도 is 찍- + -어도; 돼요 contracts 되- + -어요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee say that photography is allowed.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사진 찍다: take a photograph.

common.sentence: 공지: ‘신청은 내일까지입니다.’ 직원: ‘신청은 내일까지예요.’

language_specific.morphology: 내일 + 까지 + 이- + -에요 → 내일까지예요; 이에요 shortens to 예요 after vowel-final 까지.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice states the application deadline, and an employee expresses it in speech.

common.sentence: 안내문: “음식 반입은 안 됩니다.” 직원: “음식 가져오면 안 돼요.”

language_specific.morphology: 가져오면 is 가져오- + -면; 안 돼요 contracts 안 되- + -어요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state the same restriction on bringing food.

common.sentence: 공지: “회의는 세 시에 시작합니다.” 직원: “회의는 세 시에 시작해요.”

language_specific.morphology: 시작해요 contracts 시작하- + -여요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state the meeting's start time.

common.sentence: 공지: “좌석이 남아 있습니다.” 직원: “자리가 남아 있어요.”

language_specific.morphology: 남아 is 남- + -아; 있어요 describes the resulting state.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee report that seats remain.

common.sentence: 안내문: “이 버튼을 누르십시오.” 직원: “이 버튼을 누르세요.”

language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice gives a formal instruction; an employee gives it in polite speech.

common.sentence: 공지: “결과는 아직 나오지 않았습니다.” 직원: “결과는 아직 안 나왔어요.”

language_specific.morphology: 안 negates 나왔어요; 나왔어요 contracts 나오- + -았어요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee report that the result is not yet out.

common.sentence: 공지: “내일 문을 엽니다.” 직원: “내일 문을 열어요.”

language_specific.morphology: 열- + -어요 → 열어요.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: A notice and an employee state that the door will be opened tomorrow.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문을 열다: open the door.

common.sentence: 공지: “분실물을 보관하고 있습니다.” 직원: “분실물을 맡아 두고 있어요.”
common.meaning: is keeping something in one's care

language_specific.morphology: 맡아 is 맡- + -아; 두고 is 두- + -고; 있어요 is 있- + -어요. The -아 두고 있다 construction describes maintaining something in a resulting state.
language_specific.speech_level: formal polite written notice and informal polite spoken reformulation
language_specific.social_context: The notice uses formal polite wording; the employee restates it in informal polite speech.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 분실물을 맡아 두고 있다: keep lost property in one's care.

common.sentence: 친구가 이사하는 날 짐 나르는 일을 거들었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 거들었어요 = 거들- + -었어요, from 거들다; ㄹ is retained before the vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 짐 나르는 일을 거들다: help carry luggage.

common.sentence: 친구가 밥을 사서 저는 커피를 샀어요.
common.meaning: treat someone to a meal, so

language_specific.morphology: 밥을 사서 = 밥을 + 사- + -아서, contracted to 사서; the meal is the thing paid for.
language_specific.social_context: Friends take turns paying for food and coffee.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 밥을 사다: pay for someone's meal.

common.sentence: 초대해 주셔서 감사해요. 잘 먹겠습니다.
common.meaning: thank you for the meal; said before eating

language_specific.speech_level: informal polite thanks followed by a formal polite mealtime expression
language_specific.social_context: One guest thanks the host informally and uses a formal polite expression before eating.

common.sentence: 선생님, 바쁘실 텐데 시간 내 주셔서 감사합니다.

language_specific.morphology: 시간 내 주셔서 = 시간 + 내- + -어 주시- + -어서; 내어 contracts to 내, and 주시어서 contracts to 주셔서.
language_specific.social_context: A speaker respectfully thanks a teacher for making time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간을 내 주다: make time for someone.

common.sentence: 동료에게 사과했지만 용서는 강요할 수 없어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 용서를 강요할 수 없다: cannot force forgiveness.
language_specific.morphology: 강요하- + -ㄹ 수 없- + -어요 → 강요할 수 없어요 expresses inability to compel.

common.sentence: 그가 서류를 바꿨지만 자신은 안 했다고 발뺌했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 발뺌했어요 = 발뺌하- + -였어요; 하였 contracts to 했.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 안 했다고 발뺌하다: deny having done something to evade responsibility.

common.sentence: 동료의 제안에 반대하지만 의견은 존중해요.

language_specific.morphology: 의견은 존중해요 = 의견 + contrastive -은 + 존중하- + -어요, contracted to 존중해요.
language_specific.social_context: A speaker distinguishes disagreement from respect for a colleague's opinion.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 의견을 존중하다: respect an opinion.

common.sentence: 친구가 시험에 붙었다기에 축하 인사를 건넸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 축하 인사를 건넸어요 = 축하 인사를 + 건네- + -었어요, contracted to 건넸어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 축하 인사를 건네다: offer congratulations.

common.sentence: 이웃에게 밤에 시끄러웠던 일을 사과했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 사과했어요 = 사과하- + -였어요, contracted to 사과했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이웃에게 일을 사과하다: apologize to a neighbor for something.

common.sentence: 친구가 비밀로 해 달래서 아무에게도 말하지 않았어요.
common.meaning: because someone asked that it be kept secret

language_specific.morphology: 비밀로 해 달래서 contracts 비밀로 해 달라고 해서; 달라고 reports a request for an action for the requester.
language_specific.social_context: A friend has asked the speaker to keep something secret.

common.sentence: 할머니께서 손녀의 졸업을 진심으로 축하하셨어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses honorific language for the grandmother.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 진심으로 축하하다: congratulate sincerely.

common.sentence: 친구의 결혼식에 못 가서 축의금을 보냈어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 축의금을 보내다: send a monetary gift for a celebration.

common.sentence: 장례식장에서 친구에게 조심스럽게 위로의 말을 건넸어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 위로의 말을 건네다: offer words of comfort.

common.sentence: 친구가 부탁을 거절해도 서운해하지 않기로 했어요.
common.meaning: not to feel hurt or disappointed, as the content of a decision

language_specific.morphology: 서운해하지 않기로 = 서운해하- + -지 않- + -기로; -기로 하다 expresses a decision.
language_specific.social_context: A speaker resolves to accept a friend's possible refusal.

common.sentence: 동료가 발표를 도와줘서 덕분에 잘 마쳤어요.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker credits a colleague's help with a good outcome.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 도와줘서 덕분에: because someone helped, thanks to that help.

common.sentence: 친구에게 농담이 지나쳤다고 인정하고 사과했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 지나쳤다고 = 지나치- + -었- + -다고; 지나치었다 contracts to 지나쳤다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 농담이 지나치다: a joke goes too far.

common.sentence: 모임에서 처음 만난 분과 통성명했어요.

language_specific.morphology: 통성명했어요 = 통성명하- + -였어요, contracted to 통성명했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 분과 통성명하다: exchange names with someone.

common.sentence: 친구에게 허락을 받고 사진을 올렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 허락을 받고 = 허락 + 을 + 받- + -고; -고 links obtaining permission to the next action.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker obtains a friend's permission before posting a photo.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구에게 허락을 받다: obtain permission from a friend.

common.sentence: 친구가 제 실수를 덮어 주지 않고 알려 줬어요.

language_specific.morphology: 덮어 주지 않고 = 덮- + -어 주- + -지 않- + -고; 주다 marks an action done for someone.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 실수를 덮어 주다: cover up someone's mistake.

common.sentence: 선물을 거절한 친구의 뜻을 받아들였어요.

language_specific.morphology: 뜻을 받아들였어요 = 뜻을 + 받아들이- + -었어요, contracted to 받아들였어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구의 뜻을 받아들이다: accept a friend's wishes.

common.sentence: 비가 그치자 운동장에 고인 물이 빠졌어요.

language_specific.morphology: 물이 빠졌어요 = 물이 + 빠지- + -었어요, contracted to 빠졌어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 고인 물이 빠지다: pooled water drains away.

common.sentence: 길이 막힐지도 모르니 일찍 출발합시다.

language_specific.morphology: 막힐지도 모르니 = 막히- + -ㄹ지도 모르- + -니; the pattern expresses possibility followed by a reason.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 길이 막히다: a road becomes congested.

common.sentence: 부장님, 외람되지만 이 계획을 다시 검토해 주십시오.
common.meaning: if I may be so bold

language_specific.morphology: 외람되지만 = 외람되- + -지만; the ending introduces a qualification before the request.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker uses a deferential hedge when making a request to the department head.

common.sentence: 선생님께 제가 감사의 말씀을 올렸어요.

language_specific.morphology: 말씀을 올렸어요 = 말씀 + 을 + 올리- + -었어요; 리었 contracts to 렸.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker humbly conveys thanks to a teacher.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선생님께 감사의 말씀을 올리다: respectfully convey thanks to a teacher.

common.sentence: 회의록을 검토한 뒤 수정 사항을 공유해 주세요.

language_specific.social_context: A speaker requests that meeting-minute revisions be shared.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수정 사항을 공유하다: share revision details.

common.sentence: 이 꽃잎은 차에 넣지 마세요.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 꽃잎은 [꼰니픈]. The final consonant of 꽃 assimilates before the inserted ㄴ, and ㅍ moves to the following vowel.

common.sentence: 비는 왔지만, 경기는 계속됐어요.

language_specific.prosody: Sentence: A short pause after 왔지만 can separate the concession from the continuing event; 비는 can receive contrastive prominence.

common.sentence: 협상이 막혀 양측이 한발씩 물러섰어요.

language_specific.morphology: 한발씩 물러섰어요 = 한발 + -씩 + 물러서- + -었어요, contracted to 물러섰어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 양측이 한발씩 물러서다: both sides make concessions.

common.sentence: 회의에서는 찬성보다 반대 의견이 많았어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 반대 의견: an opposing opinion.
language_specific.root: 반 (反) means against; it differs from 반 (半), meaning half.

common.sentence: 결혼을 앞두고 양가 부모님이 상견례에서 처음 만났어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 상견례에서 만나다: meet at a formal introductory meeting; here, the two families meet before a marriage.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 상견례에서 [상견녜에서]. In 상견례, ㄹ is realized as ㄴ after ㄴ; the locative particle 에서 is included in this host.

common.sentence: 부산 친구: “고마해.” 나는 “그만해”로 알아들었다.
common.note: A regional form attributed to a friend from Busan.

language_specific.morphology: Regional 고마하- + -여 → 고마해, with 하여 → 해. The standard counterpart in this scene is 그만해.
language_specific.speech_level: casual regional quotation and standard equivalent, with plain written framing
language_specific.social_context: A friend from Busan uses a casual regional form; the narrator uses plain written language.

common.sentence: 회의 시간이 바뀌었으니 일정을 다시 확인하세요.

language_specific.morphology: 바뀌었으니 = 바뀌- + -었- + -으니; 바뀌다 is the intransitive verb for a change occurring.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시간이 바뀌다: a time changes.

common.sentence: 조사 결과는 다음과 같다. 찬성은 총 백 명이다.

language_specific.social_context: A report introduces its findings in plain written style.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 결과는 다음과 같다: the results are as follows.

common.sentence: 부장님, 보내 주신 자료를 확인했습니다.

language_specific.morphology: 보내 주신 = 보내- + -어 주시- + -ㄴ; 보내어 contracts to 보내, and 주시다 is the honorific form of the benefactive auxiliary 주다.
language_specific.social_context: A speaker respectfully acknowledges material sent by a department head.

common.sentence: 계약 조건을 꼼꼼히 따져 봅시다.

language_specific.morphology: 따져 봅시다 = 따지- + -어 보- + -ㅂ시다; 따지어 contracts to 따져.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 조건을 따져 보다: examine conditions carefully.

common.sentence: 아버지는 삯일을 해서 생활비를 버셨어요.

language_specific.morphology: 삯일을 = 삯일 + 을; 을 marks the noun as the object.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 삯일을 [상니를]. An ㄴ sound is inserted before 일, the preceding ㄱ sound becomes nasal, and the final ㄹ links to 을.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 삯일을 하다: do work for pay.

common.sentence: 제안은 좋지만 예산부터 확인해야겠어요.

language_specific.morphology: 확인해야겠어요 = 확인하- + -여야 + -겠- + -어요; 하여야 contracts to 해야, and -겠- conveys the speaker's judgment.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker responds to a proposal by raising a budget check.

common.sentence: 친구가 오해를 풀려고 먼저 말을 걸었어요.

language_specific.morphology: 말을 걸었어요 = 말을 + 걸- + -었어요, from 말을 걸다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 걸다: initiate conversation with someone.

common.sentence: 지원자는 서류를 제출한 후 접수 여부를 확인한다.

language_specific.social_context: Written instructions describe an applicant's procedure.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 접수 여부를 확인하다: check whether a submission has been received.

common.sentence: 지민아, 내가 아니라 네가 만든 거야?

language_specific.morphology: 네가 = 네 + 가; 네 is the form of 너 used before the subject particle 가.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 네가 [네가]. This is the standard pronunciation.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker addresses Jimin casually and checks who made something.
